=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:1273 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Parked items omitted from the digest because entry or overflow caps are full are classified as not parked in the next prune.
  WHY: The prune excludes only items in `entries` and `overflow`, so dropped parked items are misleadingly shown as items the unblock judge may still act on; severity is high because two reviewers marked it MAJOR and two marked it NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
(No task gaps reported.)
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:1059 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Parked items dropped due to the digest overflow cap are incorrectly listed in the "not parked" section.
  WHY: The `parked_items` set does not include items dropped from the digest because they exceed the overflow limit, so those items remain in `others` and are rendered as not-parked, misleading operators.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:1273; 1189-1195 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Items parked after both caps are full are counted as dropped without recording their numbers, so the next prune classifies them as unparked.
  WHY: Dropped items still carrying `ai:needs-human` are absent from `entries` and `overflow`, so they appear in the "Also labelled `ai:needs-human` (not parked)" section even though the judge already tried to park them.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:1194-1195, 1273 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When the digest has reached both caps, parking another item increments `dropped` without recording its number, so the prune can show a previously parked, dropped item in the “not parked” section.
  WHY: After the 200 entry and 1,000 overflow slots are full, a subsequent parked item can be included in the unparked listing on the next prune, misrepresenting its parking status.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:1273; 1062-1066; 1190-1195 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A parked item that exceeded both digest caps is counted only in `dropped`/`total_dropped` and written nowhere, so the prune renders it as not parked.
  WHY: Once the digest exceeds both caps, every subsequent prune tick re-lists those dropped parked items as not parked until their items close; this is a display-only misinformation edge, not a functional break.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
